title: Private Lab CEO and Two Others Arrested in Fake Vaccines Case
excerpt: Health authorities in Islamabad arrested three individuals, including a private laboratory CEO, for allegedly administering counterfeit vaccines.
body_html:
Health authorities have taken three individuals into custody in Islamabad following allegations involving counterfeit vaccines. Among those arrested is the chief executive officer of a well-known private laboratory.

According to the reports, the suspects are accused of administering fake vaccines to the public. Authorities detained the CEO alongside two other individuals as part of the ongoing inquiry into the matter.

Further details regarding the distribution network, the specific type of vaccines involved, and the duration of the alleged activity have not yet been disclosed by health officials as the investigation continues.
